candidate_reports.remark: Mesonet station ACRA2 Parks Highway @ Antler Creek Mp.
A spotter in Tok_ Alaska reported wind gusts of around 36 mph from 11AM to 1215 PM local time.
Alaska Power & Telephone had posted on Facebook that they had de-energized the power grid due to falling trees_ and the continued risk for trees falling onto power lines.
A spotter in Robertson River reported wind gusts up to 45 mph and power outages.
GVEA the local power company reported multiple power outages beginning early Wednesday morning_ peaking at roughly 1500 residents at around noon on Wednesday.

The Deadhorse ASOS PASC recorded a total of 0.04 inches of ice accretion between 0553Z and 0945Z. Ice likely accumulated from freezing drizzle mixed with fog as temperatures hovered near freezing.
